```dart
MaterialApp(
  theme: ndThemeData(theme: NDTheme.light, direction: NDDirection.on),
  darkTheme: ndThemeData(theme: NDTheme.dark, direction: NDDirection.on),
  highContrastTheme: ndThemeData(theme: NDTheme.lightContrast, direction: NDDirection.on),

// In a widget: context.ndColors.accentText, context.ndMetrics.sizeTargetMin
```

- Text styles: `NDTextStyle.resolve(role, platform, script).toTextStyle(platform)`; upper-case styles (`uppercase`) are applied to the string, Flutter has no text transform.
- Motion: pass `NDMotion.reduced` to `NDDurations` when `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)` is true.
- Icons and the mark: `NDVectorIcon.icon(NDIcon.arrow)` in the ambient icon colour, `NDVectorIcon(NDBrand.mark, size: 48, color: …)`.
- Fonts: IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic are this package's font assets (OFL-1.1) and the text styles use them; Chinese and monospace use the system faces.
- Shapes: `ndThemeData` gives Material's cards, dialogs, bottom sheets, popup menus and chips the kit's radii (a pill radius becomes a stadium).
